svg.title: Earn the Commission Through Five Controlled Handoffs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-exclusive-mandate-to-settlement; chart type: process_flow; title: Earn the Commission Through Five Controlled Handoffs; subtitle: Exclusive authority, verified counterparties, and documented settlement.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Applies to specialist asset and private-company transactions after jurisdiction and license review. Annual revenue means retained transaction commissions, never underlying asset value, buyer deposits, or escrow principal. First-deal timing is 3–12 months; the workflow is not a one-month closing forecast.; caption: Each handoff requires a named owner and a complete evidence packet. Automation moves records and reminders; accountable people verify authority, representations, and closing conditions.; stages: label: Classify and mandate; value: Execute scoped exclusive authority before marketing the asset.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: The principal confirms transaction form, operating jurisdictions, license requirements, seller authority, commission basis, exclusivity, excluded buyers, and tail provisions. Reject unsupported ownership claims before signing an engagement.; label: Build the evidence room; value: Reconcile seller claims against indexed supporting records.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: The document contractor assembles ownership records, operating statements, material contracts, asset lists, and lien information in SharePoint. Restrict access by role and record every material correction.; label: Match and qualify; value: Introduce authorized buyers with verified capacity and fit.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use HubSpot sector tags and Airtable buyer criteria to shortlist counterparties. Confirm decision authority, funding evidence, acquisition criteria, and confidentiality terms before releasing sensitive seller materials.; label: Negotiate and diligence; value: Track signed terms, exceptions, and unresolved closing conditions.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: The principal leads commercial negotiations while independent counsel handles transaction documents. Track LOI terms, diligence exceptions, lender dependencies, secured-party releases, and deadlines in a milestone register.; label: Settle and reconcile; value: Release the earned commission through documented settlement instructions.; numeric value: 5.0; detail: An independent escrow provider handles transaction funds. Verify changed payment instructions through a known telephone contact, reconcile the closing statement, and record only the operator's retained commission.

rect.title: label: Classify and mandate; value: Execute scoped exclusive authority before marketing the asset.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: The principal confirms transaction form, operating jurisdictions, license requirements, seller authority, commission basis, exclusivity, excluded buyers, and tail provisions. Verify changed payment instructions through a known telephone contact, reconcile the closing statement, and record only the operator's retained commission.

Assumptions: Applies to specialist asset and private-company transactions after jurisdiction and license review. Annual revenue means retained transaction commissions, never underlying asset value, buyer deposits, or escrow principal. First-deal timing is 3–12 months; the workflow is not a one-month closing forecast.
